meanings: to be for (the use or convenience of)

makemeahanzi.definition: to supply, to provide for; to offer in worship

etymology.hint: A person 亻 making an offering with both hands 共; 共 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — the one making an offering.
共 (together/both hands) — a person offering something with both hands gave 供 its meaning 'to supply, provide, offer.'

meanings: classifier for batches, lots, military flights
tier (for the ranking of universities and colleges)

makemeahanzi.definition: comment, criticism; batch, lot; wholesale

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 批 relates to an action done by hand, such as marking or sorting
比 (bǐ) gives a loose sound connection to 批's reading pī

meanings: to find (time in one's busy schedule)

makemeahanzi.definition: to squeeze, to push against; crowded

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows 挤 relates to an action done with force, like squeezing.
齐 (qí) gives a sound distantly related to jǐ, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to pick up, to gather, to collect

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 捡 describes picking something up with the hand.
佥 (qiān) gives a sound close to jiǎn, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to adopt, to accept; to receive, to take

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (silk/thread) — 纳 originally related to sewing thread into cloth, later extended to 'taking in, accepting'
内 (nèi) gives a sound close to 纳's reading nà, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: well-cooked; ripe, mature; familiar with

characterDeckComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — 熟 describes food that has been cooked thoroughly over fire.
孰 (shú) gives the sound — an exact match with 熟's reading shú.

makemeahanzi.definition: to tell, to inform, to announce; to accuse

etymology.hint: To speak 口 with the force of an ox 牛

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — the act of speaking.
牛 (ox) — traditionally read as speaking with the forceful weight of an ox, giving 告 its meaning 'to tell, announce, inform.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to check, to examine, to inspect

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 检 originally related to a wooden tally or label used for checking records
佥 (qiān) gives a sound distantly related to 检's reading jiǎn, having drifted apart over time

meanings: unit of dry measure for grain

makemeahanzi.definition: to advance; to arise; to hoist, to raise
dark, gloomy; obscure; secret, covert

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — 暗 describes the absence of light, the opposite of a bright sun.
音 (yīn) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading àn has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: armory, treasury, warehouse

etymology.hint: A stable 广 where carriages 车 are parked

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 (shelter) pictures a roofed building.
车 (cart) sits inside, together giving 库 its meaning 'storehouse, warehouse.'

makemeahanzi.definition: soldier; troops, an army; warlike

etymology.hint: Two hands 八 holding an axe 丘

characterDeckComponents.note: 八 (two hands) — gripping the weapon.
丘 (an axe/weapon) — held with both hands, the image of a person bearing arms giving 兵 its meaning 'soldier, weapon, military.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to cut, to divide, to partition; to cede

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) shows 割 relates to cutting.
害 (hài) gives a sound distantly related to gē, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: ugly; shameful; comedian, clown
widespread, universal, general

etymology.hint: Everyone 並 under the sun 日

characterDeckComponents.note: 並 (side by side, together) — represents everyone, all people.
日 (sun) — everyone standing together under the same sun gave 普 its meaning 'universal, general, widespread.'

makemeahanzi.definition: forest; luxuriant vegetation

etymology.hint: Many trees 木 forming a forest

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) is repeated three times, piling up to picture a dense forest.

makemeahanzi.definition: ride, mount; to make use of; to ascend; to multiply

etymology.hint: Two feet 北 climbing a beanstalk 禾

characterDeckComponents.note: 北 here representing two feet or footprints, one behind the other.
禾 (a stalk of grain), here standing in for a tree or ladder — together depicting someone climbing up, giving 乘 its meaning 'to ride, to get onto.'

makemeahanzi.definition: pen, prison, stable; fast, firm, secure

etymology.hint: A stable 宀 where cattle are kept 牛

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (a roof) on top represents an enclosed structure.
牛 (cattle) below is the animal kept inside, giving 牢 its meaning 'pen, stable' and later 'prison.'

makemeahanzi.definition: in charge; the palm of the hand, the sole of the foot

characterDeckComponents.note: 手 (hand) — 掌 names the palm, part of the hand.
尚 (shàng) gives a rhyme close to zhǎng, with the initial shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to squat, to crouch

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — 蹲 describes a posture involving the legs and feet.
尊 (zūn) gives a sound distantly related to dūn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: beginning, initial, primary

etymology.hint: Cutting 刀 the cloth 衤 is the first step in making clothes

characterDeckComponents.note: 衤 (clothing) — the cloth that is about to be cut
刀 (a knife) — cutting the cloth is the first step in making clothes

makemeahanzi.definition: to drip; a drop of water

characterDeckComponents.note: Water — a drip involves water or liquid.
Gives the sound dí, related to dī but drifted apart over time.

meanings: to give up or stop doing sth

makemeahanzi.definition: to warn, to admonish; to swear off, to avoid

etymology.hint: Two hands 廾 brandishing a spear 戈

characterDeckComponents.note: 戈 (a spear) in the center is the weapon being wielded.
廾 (two hands) surrounding it show hands gripping the weapon on guard, giving 戒 its meaning 'to guard against, to warn.'

makemeahanzi.definition: courtesy, manners, social customs

characterDeckComponents.note: 礻 (spirit, altar) — 礼 relates to ceremony and rites performed before the spirits.
乚 reflects the character's phonetic root, though its exact link to the modern reading lǐ is unclear today.

makemeahanzi.definition: to blow, to puff, to spray, to spurt

characterDeckComponents.note: Mouth — links to the idea of something spraying out, like spitting.
Gives the sound bēn, related to pēn but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to abandon, to throw away; to fling, to toss

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows 抛 describes throwing something with the hand.

makemeahanzi.definition: to stop, to halt; to detain; to desist

characterDeckComponents.note: 止 depicts a footprint, with toes at the top and the leg below — a simple picture of a foot, later extended to mean 'to stop.'

makemeahanzi.definition: army, military; soldiers, troops

etymology.hint: Soldiers 冖 (distorted 力) in a cart 车

characterDeckComponents.note: 冖 here is a distorted form of 力 (strength) — a simplified way of showing soldiers grouped together.
车 (cart/vehicle) — 军 originally pictured soldiers riding out to battle in war chariots.

makemeahanzi.definition: to row or paddle a boat; to scratch; to plan; profitable
secret, confidential; intimate, close; dense, thick

etymology.hint: A silent 宓 mountain 山; 宓 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 宓 depicts stillness and quiet beneath a roof.
山 (mountain) — a quiet, secluded mountain gave 密 its meaning 'dense, secret, close.'

makemeahanzi.definition: color, tint, hue, shade; beauty, form; sex

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺈ (a person, bent over) — the figure whose outward expression is being depicted.
巴 — traditionally linked to desire or emotion, so together the character points to a person's expression or complexion, extended to 色's meaning 'color, appearance.'

makemeahanzi.definition: chapter, section, writing; seal

etymology.hint: The ten 十 movements of a piece of music 音

characterDeckComponents.note: 音 (sound/music) — represents a musical piece.
十 (ten) — ten musical movements or sections making up a complete piece gave 章 its meaning 'chapter, section, composition.'

makemeahanzi.definition: girl

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 妞 (a girl) refers to a female person.
丑 (chǒu) gives a sound only distantly related to niū today, a connection that has faded over roughly three millennia of sound change.

makemeahanzi.definition: shadow; image, reflection; photograph

characterDeckComponents.note: 彡 (fine lines) — suggests light and shadow, relating to 影's meaning 'shadow, image.'
景 (jǐng) gives a sound hint — 影 is pronounced yǐng, sharing the same rhyme though the initial consonant differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: poetry; poem, verse, ode

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 诗 names words arranged in verse, poetry.
寺 (sì) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading shī has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: plum; luggage; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — 李 is the plum tree, a type of fruit tree
子 (zǐ) gives a sound close to 李's reading lǐ

makemeahanzi.definition: to struggle, to fight, to contend; measuring cup

etymology.hint: A hand holding a measuring dipper

characterDeckComponents.note: 斗 depicts a hand-held dipper or ladle used for measuring grain and liquids — giving 斗 its meaning 'a unit of dry measure,' and by extension, the Big Dipper constellation.

makemeahanzi.definition: to divine; to observe; to versify

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺊ (a divination crack/omen) — a sign to be interpreted
口 (mouth) — speaking the meaning of the omen aloud

makemeahanzi.definition: to breathe, to exhale, to sigh; to call, to shout

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 呼 describes an action of the mouth, such as calling out or breathing.
乎 (hū) gives the sound — an exact match with 呼.

meanings: we (including both the speaker and the person spoken to)

makemeahanzi.definition: we, us

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 咱 is a spoken pronoun, used in speech.
自 (zì) shares the initial z- with zán, though the rhyme has drifted.

meanings: interjection or grunt of agreement or recognition

makemeahanzi.definition: alas; exclamation of surprise or pain

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 唉 is an interjection uttered aloud, a sigh from the mouth.
矣 (yǐ) gives a sound distantly related to 唉's reading āi, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: member of the senior ministerial class

makemeahanzi.definition: scholar, gentleman; soldier
to protect, to defend, to guard against

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound/wall) — 防 relates to defensive walls and prevention
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 防 is also pronounced fáng, a close match

makemeahanzi.definition: field, open country; wilderness

characterDeckComponents.note: 里 (village, a unit of land) — 野 describes open country beyond the village.
予 (yǔ) reflects an older phonetic link, though the modern readings yě and yǔ have since diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: chivalrous person; knight-errant

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 侠 describes a certain kind of person, a hero.
夹 (jiā) gives a sound close to xiá.

makemeahanzi.definition: lake; Hubei, Hunan; bluish-green

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 湖 names a body of water, a lake.
胡 (hú) gives the sound — an exact match with 湖.

makemeahanzi.definition: net; network

characterDeckComponents.note: 网 depicts a woven mesh net stretched over a frame — a picture of a fishing or hunting net, giving 网 its meaning 'net, network.'

meanings: to build with stones, bricks etc

makemeahanzi.definition: rampart; base (in baseball)

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 垒 describes piling up earth or stones.
厽 (lěi) gives the sound — an exact match with 垒.

makemeahanzi.definition: bowl, small dish

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (stone) — early bowls were carved from stone or made of pottery.
宛 (wǎn) gives the sound — an exact match for 碗.

makemeahanzi.definition: load, burden; to carry, to bear

etymology.hint: A person 人 carrying a lot of money 贝

characterDeckComponents.note: 人 — a person, shown bending over
贝 (money/shell) — a heavy load of money the person is carrying on their back
